description: This file defines the Response class hierarchy used for method invocation responses in Orleans serialization, including completed responses, exception responses, and typed responses, along with associated codecs, activators, and extension methods.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a method invocation response, with static methods to create responses from exceptions or results, and abstract members for result and exception handling.

classes.name: CompletedResponse
classes.description: Singleton class representing a completed response with no result or exception.

classes.name: CompletedResponseActivator
classes.description: Activator class for creating singleton instances of CompletedResponse.

classes.name: ExceptionResponse
classes.description: Response class representing an exception, throws the stored exception when accessing Result or GetResult.

classes.name: Response<TResult>
classes.description: Generic response class holding a typed result, with logic for result retrieval and disposal.

classes.name: ResponseCodec
classes.description: Abstract class supporting raw serialization of Response objects.

classes.name: PooledResponseCodec<TResult>
classes.description: Codec for serializing Response<TResult> instances, using a provided codec for TResult.

classes.name: PooledResponseActivator<TResult>
classes.description: Activator for creating new Response<TResult> instances from a pool.

classes.name: ResponseExtensions
classes.description: Extension method to throw stored exceptions in Response objects.

methods.name: Response.FromException
methods.description: Creates an ExceptionResponse with the provided exception.

methods.name: Response.FromResult
methods.description: Creates a Response<TResult> with the provided value.

methods.name: Response.GetSimpleResultType
methods.description: Returns null by default; overridden in Response<TResult> to return the result type.

methods.name: Response.GetResult
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the result as type T.

methods.name: ExceptionResponse.Result
methods.description: Throws the stored exception when accessed.

methods.name: Response<TResult>.GetResult
methods.description: Returns the result cast to type T, with special handling for value types.

methods.name: Response<TResult>.Dispose
methods.description: Resets the result and returns the object to the pool.

methods.name: ResponseCodec.WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes a Response object to a writer.

methods.name: ResponseCodec.ReadRaw
methods.description: Deserializes a Response object from a reader.

methods.name: PooledResponseCodec<T>.WriteField
methods.description: Writes a Response<TResult> to a buffer, serializing the typed result.

methods.name: PooledResponseCodec<T>.ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a Response<TResult> from a buffer.

methods.name: PooledResponseCodec<T>.WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes a Response<TResult> object to a writer.

methods.name: PooledResponseCodec<T>.ReadRaw
methods.description: Deserializes a Response<TResult> object from a reader.

methods.name: PooledResponseCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Response<TResult>.

methods.name: ResponseExtensions.ThrowIfExceptionResponse
methods.description: Throws the exception stored in a Response if it exists.
